tools.name: search_properties
tools.description: Find live property listings on Showcasia (India) by city, section, locality, bedrooms and property type. Returns the public summary of each listing (type, bedrooms, locality, city) with a link to cite. Prices, photos and contact details are not returned; they are on Showcasia after free sign-in.

tools.name: get_property_evidence
tools.description: For one listing id from search_properties: how far Showcasia has checked it (identity, documents, seen on a video call or visit) and on which date.
